resources.string: Read each sentence (1× is normal reading)
Keep reading is normal. Gap to repeat leaves a silence after each sentence so you can say it back. Pause stops after every sentence until you press play.
Off until you set A. While reading, tap Set A at the first sentence and Set B at the last; reading then stays between them. Tap Clear to go back to normal reading.
A is set on page %1$d. Set B at the last sentence.
On: goes back to A after B, again and again, until you tap Clear. Off: reads A to B once and stops.
